ideas.title: Uncovering the Full Extent of Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the Feeding Our Future investigation and potential connections to other schemes.
questions: What is the total amount of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How many individuals and organizations are involved?
ideas.insight: I believe that a thorough analysis of Medicaid claims data and financial records could reveal a larger pattern of fraud, potentially involving multiple individuals and organizations.
